# Official Academic Report Templates (`docs/templates`)

Contains official Microsoft Word formatting templates provided by the College of Computing and Informatics at the University of Sharjah.

## Files

- `SDPLitRevTemp.docx`: Standard template for the Literature Review milestone submission.
- `Report_Template_SDP1_Updated_Fall_2022 (4).docx`: Official University of Sharjah template for the Senior Design Project (SDP 1) Final Report, detailing required chapter layout, fonts, margins, and declaration of originality.
